# LongStories.ai

> > Create long-form AI videos up to 15 minutes with consistent characters, music video creation, and persistent storytelling universes.

LongStories.ai is a content creator platform enabling users to generate extended AI videos with character consistency through its Universes feature. The platform serves creators at multiple tiers with flexible credit-based pricing and offers community discovery through its video feed.

## Key Topics

- AI video generation
- Character consistency
- Universes feature
- Long-form content
- Music video creation
- Prompt-to-video
- Story creation
- Creator tools
- Video templates
- Animation quality
- Content creator platform
- Video editing
- Dinoverse
- Persistent characters
- Creator economy

## Getting Started

- [LongStories.ai Homepage](https://longstories.ai): Create long AI videos up to 15 minutes with consistent characters and explore the platform's core capabilities.
- [How Universes Work](https://longstories.ai/how-it-works): Learn how to use the Universes feature to create consistent AI videos with persistent characters across multiple scenes.

## Pricing & Plans

- [Pricing](https://longstories.ai/pricing): Compare subscription tiers and credit systems for AI video creation across different user needs.
- [Creator Plan](https://longstories.ai/creator): Scale your content creation with the Creator plan offering 9,000 monthly credits for professional AI video production.

## Community & Discovery

- [Latest Videos Feed](https://longstories.ai/feed): Explore the community video feed showcasing latest AI-generated stories and music videos from other creators.
